mods.name: Pixelball
mods.description: Connects a Tiltify campaign to in-game donation rewards, goals, and a server bossbar.

releases.notes:
Major refactor of the project, improving maintainability, configurability, and runtime flexibility.

### Configuration
* Replaced generated configuration with a bundled `config.yml`.
* Reorganized the configuration into dedicated sections for improved readability.
* Added configurable BossBar colors and styles.
* Moved reward pools (Stones, Held Items, Poké Balls, and Legendaries) into the configuration.

### Tiltify
* OAuth access tokens are now cached instead of requesting a new token for every API call.
* Improved donation polling and configuration reload behavior.

### Commands
* Reworked commands under the `/pixelball` root command.
* Added `/pixelball help`.
* Added `/pixelball debug` for legendary spawn debugging.
* Added `/pixelball bypass` for per-player dimension bypasses.
* Added a permission system with support for granular permissions.

### Gameplay
* Nether and End can now be enabled or disabled at runtime without restarting the server.
* Dimension restrictions are enforced using mixins for more reliable behavior.

### Fixes & Improvements
* Fixed donation override calculations.
* Improved configuration loading and error handling.
* General code cleanup, refactoring, and project organization improvements.

## Permissions
* `pixelball.admin`
* `pixelball.reload`
* `pixelball.action`
* `pixelball.debug`
* `pixelball.bypass`
* `pixelball.donate.raised`
* `pixelball.donate.simulate`

## Notes

Existing installations should review the new `config.yml` format, as the configuration layout has changed significantly in this release.
